# Emergent_Aggregation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A self-organizing process where simple local interactions among foragers produce global clustering patterns without centralized control. Provides a model for dynamic topology formation in TCC interconnects and in-network aggregation in iNEST.
